description: This file defines the Drupal\Core\Htmx\Htmx class, which provides methods for managing HTMX attributes and headers within Drupal render arrays, facilitating AJAX and dynamic content updates using HTMX.

classes.name: Htmx
classes.description: Provides methods to generate and apply HTMX attributes and headers for Drupal render arrays, supporting AJAX interactions and dynamic content updates.

methods.name: ensureKebabCase
methods.description: Converts camelCase strings to kebab-case, or passes through if already kebab-case.

methods.name: urlValue
methods.description: Generates a URL string from a Url object and adds cache dependencies.

methods.name: createStringAttribute
methods.description: Creates and stores a string attribute with a given id and value.

methods.name: createBooleanAttribute
methods.description: Creates and stores a boolean attribute with a given id and value.

methods.name: createJsonAttribute
methods.description: Creates and stores a JSON-encoded attribute from an array.

methods.name: buildRequestAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute for a request method (GET, POST, etc.) with a URL.

methods.name: onlyMainContent
methods.description: Sets the hx-drupal-only-main-content attribute to toggle full HTML response.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Converts stored headers into Drupal HTTP header format.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header is set.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute is set.

methods.name: locationHeader
methods.description: Sets the HX-Location header with a URL or response data.

methods.name: refreshHeader
methods.description: Sets the HX-Refresh header to trigger page refresh.

methods.name: triggerHeader
methods.description: Sets the HX-Trigger header with event data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates an hx-get attribute with optional URL.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates an hx-post attribute with optional URL.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Creates an hx-put attribute with optional URL.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Creates an hx-patch attribute with optional URL.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates an hx-delete attribute with optional URL.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Creates an hx-on- event attribute for inline scripts.

methods.name: pushUrl
methods.description: Creates an hx-push-url attribute with boolean or URL.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Creates an hx-swap attribute with strategy and modifiers.
